definitions.gloss: musical piece (on a program), selection, track, program item
definitions.explanation: A piece of music as listed on a concert program, playlist, or album. Refers to the individual items in a musical performance or collection, rather than to a song in general.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{曲目|きょくもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: To check the program of the concert.

examples.japanese: ⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧{曲目|きょくもく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The performance selections have not been announced yet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リサイタル→リサイタル：27701_risaitaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{曲目|きょくもく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、ベートーベン⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ショパン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: Today's recital program includes works by Beethoven and Chopin.

notes:
USAGE:
{曲目|きょくもく} refers to specific pieces of music as items in a program, setlist, or collection. It is used when talking about what will be performed at a concert, what tracks are on an album, or what pieces a musician is preparing.

Compared to ⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧ (song/piece), {曲目|きょくもく} emphasizes the piece as an item in a list or program.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧{曲目|きょくもく}: performance program
- {曲目|きょくもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose the pieces
- {曲目|きょくもく}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of pieces
- {曲目|きょくもく}⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧: introduction of the program
